Download.legalS3a: Human Dignity: Using videos to expose people in a degrading manner is strictly prohibited, particularly in a charitable or fundraising context.

Chat.title: Local Messaging
Chat.subtitle: Secure communication over your internal network
Chat.nicknameRequired: Enter your nickname to create or join a room.
Chat.searching: Searching for rooms on the network…
Chat.noRoomsFound: No rooms found on this network.
Chat.connectionTimeout: Connection failed. The room is unreachable — check that the firewall allows Hnaya and that both devices are on the same Wi-Fi.
Chat.connectionLost: Connection to the room was lost — the host probably closed the room or left the network.
Chat.networkSetupExplain: So that other devices can connect to your room, Windows must allow Hnaya to receive connections on your local network. Click “Allow” — an administrator confirmation will be requested, once only. The permission is strictly limited to your local network.
Chat.networkSetupFailed: Permission was not granted. Without it, other devices may not be able to connect. You can try again at any time.
Chat.noRoomsHint: A room exists but doesn't show up? Allow network access, then search again.
Chat.pinHint: Share this code with the people you want to invite (verbally, on screen…).
Chat.demandeChangeable: You may change your position: the latest one stands.
Chat.demandeNotForYou: This request is addressed to someone else.
Chat.moduleNotFound: The local chat module could not be found.
Chat.securityNotice: Encrypted by PIN on this local network — not end-to-end encryption.
Chat.adminPinPrompt: Enter the room's administrator PIN (shown to the host at creation — distinct from the access PIN).
Chat.adminRetentionHint: Older messages are deleted automatically. 0 = keep forever.
Chat.manualIpHint: Room not found? Enter the server's IP address, with a port if needed — e.g. 192.168.1.10:4812 (multi-site, VPN, permanent server).
Chat.reopenTitle: Reopen a room from this computer
Chat.invitePanelHint: Offer the members of THIS room to join ANOTHER one (for example a sub-room you host). The details of your open room are pre-filled.
Chat.inviteNoHostHint: You are not hosting any room right now — enter the target room details, or create it first from the home screen.
Chat.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this room and all its history?
Chat.inviteAllHint: The invitation stays in the history — absentees will see it when they return. Any PIN included will be visible there.
Chat.inviteTargetedHint: Delivered directly to the recipient only — nothing is kept in the history.
Chat.accessBanned: Access revoked by this room's administrator.
Chat.roomLocked: Room locked: only devices already members can enter. Ask the administrator to unlock.
Chat.adminRetireDeviceHelp: Returns the licence seat of a device that no longer exists. Its record and messages are kept. To exclude a person, use "Block".
Chat.adminErrDeviceOnline: This device is connected: its seat would be taken again on its next connection. Disconnect it, or use "Block" to exclude it.
Chat.adminErrLicenceFull: Licence limit reached: free another seat first.
Chat.adminLockHint: Locked: known members come and go freely; no new device is accepted — even with the right PIN.
Chat.adminPinChangedOk: ✓ Administrator PIN changed — use the new code from the next opening.
Chat.inviteHint: Scan with the smartphone's camera (same wifi), then enter the room PIN. Keep the page open to receive messages.
Chat.inviteRoomPick: — Pick a room from this computer —
Chat.inviteRoomClosedHint: This room is not open: guests will not be able to join until you reopen it from the home screen.
Chat.adminVaultSaved: ✓ Administrator session kept on this PC.
Chat.adminVaultHint: The administration code will be kept encrypted on this device so it is no longer asked — only do this on a computer you alone use.
Chat.pinFromVault: Connected on this PC — code filled automatically
Chat.pinRemember: Stay connected to this room on this PC
Chat.pinRememberHint: The code will be kept encrypted on this device — only do this on a computer you alone use.
Chat.backToMenuHint: Back to the menu, leaving this room open (to open another one or invite to another room)
Chat.deviceLimit: This server has reached its licensed device limit. The administrator can free a slot or extend the licence with Hnaya DZ.
Chat.serverIntro: A room that stays open even with the browser closed, on an always-on machine. Reserved for organizations holding a Hnaya DZ licence — the .hnaya-lic file provided at purchase.
Chat.serverWindowsOnly: Available on Windows only for now.
Chat.serverNameAscii: Latin letters, digits, spaces, . _ - only (40 max). Rename freely later from the admin area.
Chat.serverInstall: Install the server on this computer
Chat.serverInstalled: Server installed — the room will start every time this computer boots.
Chat.serverUninstall: Remove the server from this computer
Chat.serverUninstallNote: Data (history, devices, licence) is kept: reinstalling resumes the room as it was.
Chat.serverUacNote: Windows will ask for administrator confirmation (once): startup task and firewall rules.
Chat.serverUacRefused: Administrator authorization refused or interrupted — the operation did not complete.
Chat.mediaQuotaBytes: Upload limit reached for this device (200 MB per hour). Try again later.
Chat.mediaQuotaFiles: Too many files sent from this device in the past hour. Try again later.
Chat.mediaTypeRefused: This file type is not allowed in messaging.
Chat.mediaBusy: Too many transfers at once — wait for the current uploads to finish.
Chat.mediaImageFailed: This image could not be read. Its extension claims a format its contents do not match - commonly an iPhone photo saved as ".jpg" while actually being HEIC. Open it and save it again as JPEG or PNG.
Chat.mediaGone: This attachment is no longer available on the host computer.
Chat.mediaIntegrity: The received file does not match what was announced — download aborted.
Chat.mediaMicDenied: Microphone unavailable — check that it is plugged in and allowed.
Chat.addMyPhoneHint: Scan with YOUR phone: it joins the room under your own nickname, without creating a second one. Then enter the PIN — it is never in the QR code.
Chat.rosterEmpty: Nobody else has joined this room yet.
Chat.threadEmpty: No messages in this private conversation yet.
Chat.serverErrPin: The access PIN must be 6 digits.
Chat.serverErrAdminPin: The admin PIN must be 6 digits.
Chat.serverErrName: The room name contains characters that are not allowed (Latin letters, digits, spaces, . _ - only).
Chat.serverErrWindowsOnly: The permanent server is available on Windows only for now.
Chat.mediaDecodeFailed: This audio file could not be read or converted — it may be corrupted or in a format the browser does not support.
Chat.voteNotNamedHint: The link between a person and their choice will not be stored. You will know who answered, not what each one answered. The ballot is final: a non-nominative vote cannot be changed. This is not a secret ballot — the room host sees the answers arrive.
Chat.serverLicenceReuse: Use the licence already on this machine
Chat.serverLicenceGone: No licence is present on this machine.

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.alwaysOn: Always-on protections: encrypted DNS, WebRTC local-IP leak prevention, "Do Not Track" signal and background telemetry removal.
Privacy.blockTrackersDesc: Blocks known audience-measurement and ad-tracking services (Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, Hotjar…).
Privacy.cleanLinksDesc: Removes tracking parameters from visited addresses (utm_, fbclid, gclid…).
Privacy.troubleshoot: If a website misbehaves (Facebook login, missing content…), temporarily disable these protections and reload the page. Changes apply immediately.
